subject: Exception request: international relocation & visa coverage for offer — Elena Korhonen
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Exception request: international relocation & visa coverage for offer — Elena Korhonen

Hi Laura —

Following up on the verbal green-light from Vivek: we are ready to extend an offer to Elena Korhonen (c/o HealthNordic). She is a senior infra SWE we interviewed for RED-5478. Offer: base USD 170k + target 15% bonus (mid of band).

Two complicating factors: Elena requires work authorization sponsored from EU -> US and would relocate with one dependent. The mobility partner provided an initial estimate (attached) showing:
- Immigration/legal fees (attorney + filing): $18,200
- Expedited flights & temporary housing: $3,200
- Household shipment / final-mile: $5,400
Total estimate: $26,800.

Our standard relocation stipend is $12,000 and the standard policy does not cover attorney/legal filing costs beyond a small admin allowance. Given candidate quality and the timeline (needs visa started now to meet an anticipated Jan 15 start), I am requesting an exception to:
1) Cover immigration/legal fees up to $18,200 (Redwood pays directly to immigration counsel).
2) Increase the relocation cap for this offer to $25,000 (one-time exception) to cover expedited costs and household shipment.

Attachments: immigration-estimate_elk.xlsx, mobility-quote-jonas.pdf.

If approved, I will attach the signed offer and coordinate payments with Finance & our mobility partner Jonas (jonas@mobilityco.com).

Quick asks:
- Laura: HR approval needed for policy exception + sign-off cadence (who else needs to sign?).
- Vivek: confirm headcount/manager budget (FY27 bucket) so I can finalize comp.

Thanks —
Jordan
Senior Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jonas Nystrom <jonas@mobilityco.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exception request: international relocation & visa coverage for offer — Elena Korhonen

Jordan —

Thanks for the note and the attachments. I pulled the mobility estimate and mobility quote into the HR review queue. A couple of items before I can sign an exception:

1) Please confirm the final on-target compensation (total cash + equity budget implications) so I can mark the approval with Finance.
2) Provide a one-line justification for the exception (candidate scarcity/critical skill/time-to-fill) — we usually need this for audits.
3) Confirm whether Redwood will pay counsel directly (recommended) or reimburse the candidate. Direct payment requires a mobility vendor contract; Jonas, can you confirm you can invoice Redwood directly for counsel and relocation milestones?

I'm tagging Finance's approval matrix: exceptions > $20k require HR + manager + Finance (People Ops escalation if policy variance). If Vivek confirms headcount/budget this morning I can route to Finance and get a sign-off by EOD.

Attaching: mobility-quote-jonas.pdf (copied) and a short exception form (filled partially).

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: mobility-quote-jonas.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exception request: international relocation & visa coverage for offer — Elena Korhonen

Laura / Jordan —

Confirmed: headcount for RED-5478 is approved in the FY27 hiring plan (team allocation 3.2). We have budget headroom in infra hiring to cover a one-time uplift provided we treat the immigration legal fees as a separate line item and not a permanent band increase.

I am comfortable approving the following, effective for this candidate only:
- Redwood covers immigration/legal fees up to $18,200 (paid directly to counsel).
- Redwood covers expedited flights and temporary housing up to $3,200.
- Relocation stipend remains at the standard $12,000 for household move and incidentals. If Elena requires additional shipment costs above standard, we will consider reimbursement after receipts up to a $5,000 supplemental but only if justified and approved by People Ops.

Total potential company spend ceiling: $18,200 (legal) + $3,200 (expedited travel) + $12,000 (relocation stipend) + up to $5,000 on receipts = $38,400 maximum, but expected ~ $26,800 per the estimate. This is a one-off exception tied to this hire.

Laura: please confirm Finance route and any PO/contract requirements. Jordan: once Laura approves, proceed to generate the offer and mark the exception in the offer packet.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Infrastructure Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Nystrom <jonas@mobilityco.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exception request: international relocation & visa coverage for offer — Elena Korhonen

Jordan / Vivek —

Final: HR + Finance have signed off on the exception under the terms Vivek laid out. Finance will require Jonas to submit an invoice to AP (invoicing instructions attached) and a PO referencing requisition RED-5478. Laura from Finance (copied offline) will release payment milestones once we receive signed counsel engagement.

Jordan — please proceed to:
- Send the formal offer to Elena with the exception language included (see paragraph below).
- Upload the signed offer to the candidate Drive folder and send the DocuSign link to Elena.
- Introduce Jonas to the candidate and copy AP for invoicing.

Exception paragraph (please paste into the offer packet):
"Redwood Inference will pay immigration counsel and related filing fees for Elena Korhonen up to a cap of USD 18,200 and will cover expedited travel and temporary housing up to USD 3,200. Standard relocation stipend of USD 12,000 will apply for household move; any supplemental shipping reimbursement up to USD 5,000 must be pre-approved by People Operations and accompanied by receipts. This exception is a one-time accommodation tied to this offer and does not change Redwood relocation policy or compensation bands."

Attachments: signed-offer-elk.pdf (placeholder), immigration-estimate_elk.xlsx, mobility-quote-jonas.pdf
